lines.en: I drift over the Otherside's stone platforms.
My feet never find solid ground.
Dust follows me and will not settle.
Cold is left where I pass.

lines.zh: 这世界的天一直是灰的。
lines.en: The sky of this world is always grey.

lines.zh: 我拖着一条看不见的链子。
lines.en: I drag a chain no one can see.
I walk long and go nowhere.
I pass through a thin wall.

lines.zh: 我的骨节在响，没有骨头。
lines.en: My joints creak with no bones.
Other lost souls drift along with me.

lines.zh: 我的影子比这世界还淡。
lines.en: My shadow is fainter than the world.
I step on ash; the ash does not stir.
I am trying to recall where I died.
My chest is empty and cold.
I cannot count how many years passed.
No wind here, yet I sway.
I hear someone far off call my name.
There are no lines on my hands.
Waiting lasts longer than living did.

lines.zh: 我记得一张脸，忘了名字。
lines.en: I recall a face, not a name.
Ash settles on my shoulder and stays.
I try to breathe; it does nothing.

lines.zh: 你呵出的气是白的，热的。
lines.en: Your breath comes out white and warm.
Your eyes move; how new.
I used to be like that.
Your spot has a shadow.
Can you see me?
Can you count your own years?
Your hand shakes. Afraid of me?

lines.zh: 你身上有汗味，是活的证据。
lines.en: Your sweat is proof something lives.
I stare at you, trying to remember.
You walk loudly; I make no sound.
Your blow found me, somehow.
I do not bleed; a little ash scatters.
It hurts, but I have died already.
That blow scattered a corner of me.
I gathered myself again, see?

lines.zh: 别白费力气，我一百二十五点。
lines.en: Save your strength; I have a hundred twenty-five.
Your blade found air and ash.
Good aim, but useless.
My outline has faded some.
I am nearly gone; hit once more.
I cannot touch the things of the living.
Give it to me; I still cannot hold it.
I smell warm food in your hand.

lines.zh: 我早就不知道饿是什么。
lines.en: I have long forgotten hunger.
You lift it; I reached anyway.
I want nothing anymore.

lines.zh: 这味道让我想起一顿饭。
lines.en: This smell recalls a meal.

lines.zh: 我张嘴，嘴里什么也没有。
lines.en: I open my mouth; nothing is there.
Put it away; I do not eat.
The closer I come, the colder it gets.
You strike me and pass through.
I am as cold as stone.
Touch me and your fingers numb.

lines.zh: 我们相碰，你的速度没变。
lines.en: We meet and your pace does not change.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀从我胸口穿过去。
lines.en: Your shoulder goes through my chest.
I cannot dodge, and I did not try.

lines.zh: 这一撞让我想起还有形状。
lines.en: The bump reminds me I have a shape.
A layer of ash clings to you.
We touch without a sound.
Stand back; the living get cold.
Souls neither bear nor break.

lines.zh: 我们并排飘着，仅此而已。
lines.en: We drift side by side, nothing more.

lines.zh: 我记得爱过谁，忘了是谁。
lines.en: I remember loving someone, not who.

lines.zh: 两个空的凑一起还是空。
lines.en: Two empties make one empty.

lines.zh: 我们碰一碰，就各自走了。
lines.en: We brush and each drifts off.
No child is born here.

lines.zh: 我的手握不住另一只手。
lines.en: My hand cannot hold another.
We mistook each other's faces.
I stay with it until it comes apart.

lines.zh: 我们之间隔着很远的灰。
lines.en: Ash lies far between us.
I stoop; my hand passes through the stone.
What falls goes straight through me.
I try to pinch a flake of ash.

lines.zh: 这具身体拿不了任何东西。
lines.en: This body takes hold of nothing.

lines.zh: 我碰过的东西都会变冷。
lines.en: Whatever I touch grows cold.

lines.zh: 我把地上的铁看了一遍。
lines.en: I looked over the iron on the ground.

lines.zh: 我没有留下能捡的东西。
lines.en: I leave nothing that can be picked up.

lines.zh: 我的手指从它中间滑过。
lines.en: My fingers slide through it.

lines.zh: 你捡吧，那本来该是我的。
lines.en: Pick it up; it should have been mine.

lines.zh: 我什么都不带，走得很轻。
lines.en: I carry nothing and walk light.
You are alive too loudly.
You entered the Otherside; I smelled it.

lines.zh: 我在你身上看到旧样子。
lines.en: I see my old shape on you.

lines.zh: 你的热气在灰里很显眼。
lines.en: Your warmth stands out in the ash.
I will keep you here.
You stepped where I died.

lines.zh: 我的手指已经伸出来了。
lines.en: My fingers have come out.
You looked back, like I once did.

lines.zh: 这里不需要第二个活人。
lines.en: This place needs no second living thing.
Time still moves on you.
I never think before I reach.
The ash starts gathering toward you.
You are the only heat here.
I want your company a while.
Your steps wake the ash.

lines.zh: 你身上还有温度，我要那个。
lines.en: You still have warmth. I want that.

lines.zh: 我贴在你背后，你感觉不到。
lines.en: I am at your back; you cannot feel it.
Where you go, ash gathers.
I wait for your second glance back.

lines.zh: 你举起武器，也打不到我。
lines.en: Raise your weapon; it cannot reach me.

lines.zh: 你喘得越来越急，我数着。
lines.en: You gasp faster and faster; I count.

lines.zh: 这里的每块石头我都熟。
lines.en: I know every stone here better.
I press closer, slowly.

lines.zh: 你的心跳是我唯一的时间。
lines.en: Your heartbeat is my only clock.
I am leading you into the ash.

lines.zh: 你不必跑，这里没有出口。
lines.en: Do not run; there is no way out.

lines.zh: 我在你走过的路上等着。
lines.en: I wait on the path you already walked.

lines.zh: 你一站住，我就停在你影里。
lines.en: When you halt, I halt inside your shadow.

lines.zh: 你的影子朝我这边偏了。
lines.en: Your shadow has tilted my way.

lines.zh: 你听见那一声叹气了吗？
lines.en: Did you hear that sigh?

lines.zh: 我把你的影子压得很薄。
lines.en: I press your shadow thin.

lines.zh: 你往亮处退，那里也归我。
lines.en: Retreat to the light; it is mine as well.

lines.zh: 我把手放在你肩后一寸。
lines.en: I hold my hand an inch behind your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你每走一步，灰就高一分。
lines.en: Every step you take, the ash rises.
I do not block your way. I only follow.

lines.zh: 你听见的窸窣声，是灰在挪动。
lines.en: That rustling is the ash shifting.

lines.zh: 我的手穿过护甲碰到你。
lines.en: My hand passes the armor and touches you.
That strike leaves frost in the bone.
I take a little of your heat.
The cold slows you by a beat.

lines.zh: 我抓你的喉咙，抓了个空。
lines.en: I grab your throat and catch nothing.
Thirteen points is enough to remember.

lines.zh: 我的指甲没有实体，但疼。
lines.en: My nails are not real; the pain is.
You retreat; it is colder there.

lines.zh: 我在你的伤处按了一下。
lines.en: I pressed on your wound.

lines.zh: 这一击把你魂抽走一点。
lines.en: This strike pulls a little soul out.
I hold you and you go cold.
You swing; the blade meets only ash.
I hit you because I am still here.
Your being alive angers me.

lines.zh: 我抬手，你的护甲里结了霜。
lines.en: I raise my hand; frost forms inside your armor.

lines.zh: 这一下你没感觉，它留在里面。
lines.en: You do not feel this one. It stays inside.

lines.zh: 我的手指从你肋骨间穿过去。
lines.en: My fingers pass between your ribs.

lines.zh: 你捂着的伤，已经不烫了。
lines.en: The wound you clutch is no longer warm.

lines.zh: 我松开手，你的膝盖先弯。
lines.en: I let go, and your knees give first.

lines.zh: 这一击让你想起自己也会死。
lines.en: This blow reminds you that you can die.

lines.zh: 我在异位的灰里睁开眼睛。
lines.en: I open my eyes in the Otherside's ash.

lines.zh: 有人死在这里，就有了我。
lines.en: Someone died here, and so I am.

lines.zh: 我从一具旧尸里浮起来。
lines.en: I rise out of an old corpse.

lines.zh: 这地方一个接一个地生我。
lines.en: This place makes me again and again.

lines.zh: 我生来就记不起生前的事。
lines.en: I was born forgetting my life.
The ash heaps itself into my shape.

lines.zh: 我从灰里坐起，呼出凉气。
lines.en: I sit up from the ash and exhale cold.

lines.zh: 我一站起，世界就暗一层。
lines.en: As I stood, the world dimmed.

lines.zh: 异位的石板下总有我们。
lines.en: We are always under these slabs.

lines.zh: 我没有名字就被扔在这。
lines.en: I was dropped here without a name.

lines.zh: 我的影子先出现，身体后到。
lines.en: My shadow came first, my body after.
On this ash I open my eyes again.
Fire lights me and I feel warm.

lines.zh: 我从台上掉下去，没有响。
lines.en: I fall from the platform without sound.
Water neither enters me nor leaves.

lines.zh: 炸开的灰在半空拼回我。
lines.en: The blasted ash reassembles me in midair.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，扎进后面的墙。
lines.en: The arrow goes through and sticks in the wall.

lines.zh: 那道光让我想起自己的名字。
lines.en: That light almost names me.
I have had no stomach for ages.

lines.zh: 闪电照出我的影子，很淡。
lines.en: Lightning shows my shadow, faint.

lines.zh: 我掉进虚空，和这里也差不多。
lines.en: I fall into the void, much like here.
